name: Command and Windows help
summary: Explain commands, git recipes, Windows shortcuts and Run commands
author: friday-core
description: A reference desk for the command line and for Windows itself. It holds 3 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Command explainer: What a git, docker, npm, pip, winget, robocopy, PowerShell, curl or chmod command does, flag by flag, with danger warnings. Git recipes: The exact git commands for common situations such as undoing a commit or fixing the wrong branch. Windows reference: Keyboard shortcuts, Run-box commands and ms-settings pages found by what you want to do.
